research_notes: The boundary search should record any automatic/runtime termination separately from an explicit voluntary close at the target.
A voluntary close just after target demonstrates survival to that class; it does not locate the true maximum.
That is why coarse ascent continues after each pass.
The first credible involuntary/failed close supplies the upper-region evidence.
This design avoids intentionally running every successful sample until failure, which would risk unnecessary checkpoint loss.
The present 14m probe should close normally at the first safe boundary after target.
